fit_coefficients.definition: q(t)=c*cos(omega1*t)+s*sin(omega1*t), fixed omega1 from the contract oracle
fit_coefficients.method: numpy.linalg.lstsq on all archived samples, no trimming

fit_coefficients.time_window: all archived samples including t=0 and final time

fstar.source: Ustar=norm(u0_free,2)>0; Vstar=omega1*Ustar; Astar=omega1^2*Ustar; Fstar=max(norm(K*u0,2),norm(M*a0,2),1 N); E0=0.5*u0.T*K*u0>0. Freeze these from the oracle initial state, not the run error.
fstar.source_level: B10 dt_t1_20 initial state plus independent B2 K/M oracle

continuity.metric: max norm(u_left(shared,j)-u_right(shared,j),infinity)/max(abs(u0)) using independently gathered local family states and verified shared ID mapping

energy_transfer.metric: P_left=g_left.T*v_I and P_right=g_right.T*v_I; cumulative W_left,W_right by trapezoidal integration at every sample. INTERFACE_ENERGY_ERROR=max_j abs(W_left_j+W_right_j)/E0; also report integral(abs(P_left+P_right))/E0 and gross exchanged work as diagnostics

force_transfer.metric: For each shared node set I, g_f=(sum elements in family(Ke*u_e+Me*a_e))_I. max_j norm(g_left+g_right,2)/Fstar; archive both side vectors, not only their sum

normalizations_from_contract.interpretation: Effective discrete nodal interfacial work including consistent-mass inertial terms, not continuum stress-flux validation. Also archive each family's kinetic/strain energies and its interface work to examine unexplained energy change. Fixed supports have zero work; shared nodes are free/unforced.

interface_metrics.source: B10 measured interface evidence; no hardcoded continuity replacement

micro_run.purpose: contract-compliance smoke only; not a replacement for B10 campaign evidence

main.source: B10 linear_execution.iteration_count_total plus direct solve contract (one iteration per step)

replay_1.source: B10 direct replay metadata and direct solve semantics

replay_2.source: B10 direct replay metadata and direct solve semantics

residual.definition: max_j norm((M*a_j+C*v_j+K*u_j-F_j)_free,2)/Fstar; independently reconstruct using archived operators
residual.fstar_source: contract metric_definitions.scales evaluated from frozen oracle initial state
residual.old_metric_preserved: B10 residual_relative arrays remain unchanged in their source archive
